title: Section 22 — Power to transfer suits which may be instituted in more than one Court — CPC 1908

content.heading: Power to transfer suits which may be instituted in more than one Court
content.text: Where a suit may be instituted in any one of two or more Courts and is instituted in one of those Courts, any defendant, after notice to the other parties, may, at the earliest possible opportunity and in all cases where issues are settled at or before such settlement, apply to have the suit transferred to another Court, and the Court shall determine in which of the several Courts having jurisdiction the suit shall proceed.
